notes.title: Patch 1.4.0 is Live!
notes.content:
Patch v1.4.0 is live!

Changed:
[list]
[*] Settings for the Self Care Minigame Highlight Tiles - changed from a toggle to a dropdown with 3 options - All (Easy), Latest (Normal), and None (Hard). "All (Easy)" will now highlight the only tiles possible for all the selected tiles and will stay highlighted even if you run into an intrusive thought. "Latest (Normal)" is the same as when the old setting used to be checked - meaning it only highlights the tiles from the last one you selected. "None (Hard)" is the same as when the old setting used to be unchecked - meaning it never highlights based on what you select. Hope this new setting helps to make the self care minigame a bit easier!
[/list]

Fixed:
[list]
[*] UI fixes (text overflow, text alignment)
[*] Fixed memories board sometimes not showing the exclamation point when there is an epilogue to view
[/list]

Reminder that you can submit a bug report through Google forms: [url=https://forms.gle/nz2RoMXXumem8JNi9]https://forms.gle/nz2RoMXXumem8JNi9[/url] or you can also email me directly at info@janbehgames.com Thanks!

notes.title: Love, Ghostie Steam Next Fest Stream #2
notes.content:

In Love, Ghostie, you become a wholesome ghost matchmaker and grow relationships between the manor’s residents! Gift items to lift their spirits, set them up on dates, and watch love bloom! notes.title: Ghostie Songs and Demo Update
notes.content:
One of the new features we’ve added in Love, Ghostie is the ability to sing to your residents!

We were inspired by Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time where you can play different songs that have different effects!

Here is the “happy song”:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591309/3902d19fbca7e41c92bb58506de83652daf4000b.gif[/img]

Here’s a link to the original video on Twitter where you can hear it with sound: [url=https://twitter.com/janbehchanbeh/status/1772714975485735338]https://twitter.com/janbehchanbeh/status/1772714975485735338[/url]

This was so fun to design and our composer, Sam, did an amazing job coming up with 4 very different songs with only 4 notes!

In other news, we’ve finished the ending of Love, Ghostie and added New Game+. It’s all coming together and it’s a mix of feeling excited, scared, and relieved that we’re getting closer to the finish line!

As a heads up, I’ll be taking down the demo starting early next week! But don’t worry, we’ll be back with an updated demo soon. It’ll (most likely) feature all the characters available and will allow you to try out some of the new upgrades!

Thanks so much for your patience and for reading!

- Jennifer

notes.title: Minigame Updates + New Resident Room
notes.content:
January has been a solid month for progress!

I've been heads down on finishing up the minigames, so sorry for the lack of updates on socials! I'm so excited to say that I'm really happy with the minigames. I think I prototyped ~6 different minigames and unfortunately some ended up not being very fun. But, now I’ve finalized 3 new minigames + 1 pseudo minigame that I'm happy with!

We’re planning on doing some internal playtesting soon, and I hope to share the new minigames once we’ve polished them up!

A lot of development time is currently being used for polishing and adding quality-of-life features! Unfortunately, that means I don’t have as much “fun” stuff to show off, but I know that all this polish time will help create a better experience overall. I’ve also gotten a lot better at designing UI over time, so I have been going back to older menus to fix those up! I know some of the menus in the current demo aren’t the best, but don’t worry - they’re fixed up now 🙂

I also plan to have an updated demo out before the release, so stay tuned for that!

Here's a sneak peek of Apollo’s room:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591309/8316e0e8a72cce54bec2e9a90f57d6cc1a15694f.gif[/img]

It also features decoration mode, if you haven’t seen it yet! It allows you to switch which items the residents put up in their room. You’ll also be able to decorate the common rooms with items from your inventory if you’d like.

Thanks for your patience and for all your support!

- Jennifer

notes.title: Decoration Mode + Sneak Peak at New Resident Room!
notes.content:
As hinted in the Deaddit forums in the demo, we’re including a simple way to “redecorate” resident rooms.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591309/b8c6adc8c480ff7e000626a9928f3ccc8a79b199.png[/img]

We’ve gotten lots of questions asking how to re-decorate or remove an item that didn’t match with a resident’s room. It’s not available in the demo (sorry!) but here’s a preview of what it’ll look like.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591309/191429aef0629d4f46b2690141c38403df9d3b86.gif[/img]

No more pizzas on the bed now!! 😂 (unless you want to keep it there)

Here’s a sneak peek of Chamel’s room, which wasn’t available in the demo. Chamel is a chameleon cosplayer, as you might be able to tell from their room.

We're working on lots of feedback from the demo, including other quality-of-life features, such as a log to review dialogue. I always hate it when I accidentally skip a line and can't see what I missed, so I definitely wanted to include a log!

We're working hard towards the final release, thanks so much for all the support and feedback on the demo so far!

- Jennifer

notes.title: Guess what works on a Steam Deck?
notes.content:
I got a Steam Deck a couple months ago, and I love it so far! I personally don’t like playing games on my computer, since I’m on my computer all day for work. The Steam Deck has been a perfect way to relax on my couch and it’s awesome to be able to hook it up to my tv.

We’re getting so close to getting a public demo out, and I’m very focused on polish / bug fixing, but I also recently added full controller support. After I got that working, I thought to myself: “Hmmmmm…lemme just try to see if I can get it to work on Steam Deck.” I spent a little time setting it up and guess what? It works!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591309/6640d24136633f698ccd1b59722fb2cd36b608c8.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591309/500a5c2a5e12728a9c38b7b33ead9781bc1971da.jpg[/img]

I was honestly surprised at how easy it was to set up and get running. I did a couple playthroughs of the demo on the Steam Deck and made some adjustments to UI elements that were too small on the Deck.

Here are some videos of Love, Ghostie on the Steam Deck: https://twitter.com/janbehchanbeh/status/1644762601388408832 

It’s very exciting! I really can’t wait for the demo to come out. I’ve spent the past ~5 months playtesting, iterating, playtesting, iterating, etc and the demo is finally in a place that I’m very happy with (minus some bugs that still need to be fixed 😛). I can’t wait to share it with you all!

Thanks for reading and make sure to wishlist Love, Ghostie if you haven’t already!

- Jennifer

notes.title: The #1 Forum Site for Ghosties
notes.content:
First off - let me apologize for missing last month’s devlog! Just when I think things CAN’T possibly get busier - they do! But know that each day that goes by brings us closer to having that demo out! In fact, I’ve been having tons of playtests recently, so I’d like to share some of my learnings and my ways of addressing issues!

Something I learned is that lots of playtesters are afraid of “doing the wrong thing” or “committing to something permanent” at the beginning of the game - which is totally reasonable!

At first, I thought it was a little weird because "hey, it’s a game - just try it out!" But when I thought about it more, it made a lot of sense. Love, Ghostie’s gameplay can APPEAR to be more “permanent” because setting up couples is a way bigger decision or outcome than something like growing a crop in a farming sim.

Some playtesters were fine with experimenting, while others were afraid to commit to certain actions. So…how do I address this without throwing a bunch of text to explain how everything works? I already have a lot of tutorial text (but tried to make it as entertaining as possible!!), so I definitely don’t want to add more.

I recently created “Deaddit" which is a forum site on the ghost internet that you have access to. It was originally supposed to be a later feature, since it was only intended for world-building purposes. However, I opted to implement it sooner to address these “frequently asked questions,” which serve as guidance for players.

I’ve created forum posts of “common” questions that are posted by other ghost matchmakers, but they’ve actually been real player concerns from playtests!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591309/6c8f49d07e771f6c4cc0f63d6989df880e477fc0.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591309/f87f24fccb305bfe1b367ac5711e49b59160daef.png[/img]

Plus, it’s way more entertaining to read than a bunch of tutorial text. But, don’t worry - I still have the world-building forums, like this conspiracy theorist ghost who is convinced they live in a simulation…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591309/0d99996b6780a619372db3fe73a10095018feb34.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591309/bdd52482620e7c8486593c3ebd4a691a7b3caf19.png[/img]

but that's absurd, what kind of person would build this silly, wacky world...right? 😐 ha ha ha

That's it for this month! Make sure to wishlist Love, Ghostie if you haven’t already!

- Jennifer

notes.title: Cute Opening and New Music Reveal!
notes.content:
2023 has kicked off and it’s already so busy!

I’m currently working on “boring” (but very essential) stuff right now, so I haven’t been as active on social media as I’d like to be. Settings, UI, saving/loading, fixing bugs, controller support, lots of playtests, etc! But hey, that means we’re getting closer and closer to getting that demo out!

I wanna show off something the whole team recently worked on!

You may have noticed some new key art on the Steam page, done by the wonderful Bing! 

I love it a lot more than the previous art - plus, we’re hinting at a few more residents that you can ship! My favorite is the penguin, Wobbles! I’ve loved penguins my entire life, so I’m heavily biased 😛. (Happy Penguin Awareness Day by the way!!)

I created this cute opening sequence for our main menu:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591309/5ca2549003c0039eb3808d98f2fcbc7d719dd677.gif[/img]

You can watch the [url=https://twitter.com/janbehchanbeh/status/1613630556318896128]full version here with music![/url]

There's an [b]AMAZING[/b] theme that Sam wrote for it! It has that ghostie feel, but is still super cozy and [b]AH I JUST LOVE IT!![/b] (I play piano as a hobby, so I’m a [b]HUGE[/b] sucker for piano in video game music 😂)

I really can’t wait for you all to try out the demo and see all the amazing work the team has done so far! 

Sorry for the short update, but working on “boring” stuff isn’t really that exciting to show off  😂 - hope to share more soon!

- Jennifer

notes.title: Happy Holidays from the Ghostie team + Unique Animations!!
notes.content:
Happy holidays!! Can’t believe it’s already that time of year.

Me realizing that 2023 is just around the corner:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591309/fd9539dee0e5bb0e76b3b4a05405cc9afb4d8f85.gif[/img]

I know I’ll be spending the holidays getting in as much relaxation as possible! We have a lot of exciting things planned and that just means a busy 2023! (When are things [b]NOT[/b] busy??? 😂)

We’re working hard on a demo right now and it’s coming together really nicely! I’m really excited to share it with you all - hopefully soon! I can’t wait to see all of your reactions to the characters and see who’s your favorite! And more importantly, who’s your favorite [b]SHIP?![/b]

We’re really trying to make each character’s personality shine through their interests, room, animations, diary entries, and something else that we haven’t revealed yet 👀 (it’s a surprise!)

Speaking of that, we’ve added special idle animations that are unique for each character!
Check them out below:

[h2]Mina[/h2]
Streeeeeeeeeetch!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591309/33831f5845678add42a0de2becb22ca0d3ef7073.gif[/img]

[h2]Gerard[/h2]
Always listening to music 🎶

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591309/d888d38b359e104b05ef5412105576559874c123.gif[/img]

[h2]Calathea[/h2]
Slow and deep breaths, absorbing that light 💡

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591309/67f1305b1c31ce75f59aea4c6070871aeaba6559.gif[/img]

[h2]Noir[/h2]
Keeping up with the latest fashion trends 🛍️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591309/d1729568016fc2a5ac547d4b9c42b5882b7b4f9d.gif[/img]

It’s a small detail, but it’s really nice to be flying around the house as Ghostie and see them occasionally do their own thing! 

Well, it’s time for me to start my vacation - hope you all have a great holiday and take care of yourselves!

Until next time!
- Jennifer

notes.title: Introducing another...GHOSTIE?!
notes.content:
Okay, I’ve been doing these monthly resident introductions…but I decided it would be nice to introduce another Ghostie this month instead!

If you follow me on social media:

[url=https://twitter.com/janbehchanbeh]Twitter[/url]
[url=https://www.instagram.com/janbehchanbeh/]Instagram[/url]
[url=https://www.tiktok.com/@janbehchanbeh]TikTok[/url]

you may have already seen the introduction of Ghostina...Aghoulera. HEH.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591309/416b0be76126c1d398a80da2069ff027d823855c.png[/img]

Ghostina acts as your mentor, since you’re newly…deceased. She’ll teach you how to be a matchmaker and is your introduction to the afterlife!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41591309/2345630b1618e4fc18d3e48b5b51d16e7e1e17e7.gif[/img]

I LOVE GHOSTINA! She's so sassy. I'm super excited to share more of her. Every time I read her dialogue, she cracks me up. And then I'm giggling to myself at my desk while I work...good thing there's no one around me to witness it 😅

Things have been super busy on our end, both for Love, Ghostie and our personal lives. But, I'm happy to say that we've been making huge progress in the past several months and while I want to blurt out everything we're working on, I have to be patient 🙈 unfortunately, these things take time, but we're working REALLY hard towards getting a demo out! Stay tuned for more!

- Jennifer
